notes.title: PANELKI 1.4.1. Polish language and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello Poland! 
PANELKI are now available in Polish! Welcome to the endless cold city.

In addition, in update 1.4.1, now defaults to heating in all houses in Delivery DLC, as well as fixing several text bugs and issues with falling from heights.

Also, there is a nice discount on the game with the Steam Fall sale!

The author of Polish localization is Władysław Jakowienko. Translate the game into Polish: wladyslaw.jakowienko@gmail.com.

Join the game community in Discord: https://discord.gg/trrgWXYjkz

notes.title: PANELKI 1.4.0 MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41972196/0e2e9e1d524118cff08c028d251289f33bd4621d.jpg

Dear players! I have been working on a new project with my team for over a year now, so it was decided to stop supporting PANELKI, including the release of updates. However, I regularly receive feedback with a variety of content, including both extremely positive feedback, which makes me incredibly happy, and requests to fix certain problems in order to enjoy the game with comfort - mostly about the impossibility to play on AMD graphics cards of some series. 

Because of this, I decided to allocate some time for an update that I can call the last one (not counting hotfixes or minor changes), at least for now.

To fix the “AMD-gate”, I decided to update the game project to Unreal Engine 5 at once, at the same time getting improvements in graphics and performance (I hope), as well as adding those changes to the game that it has been waiting for a long time.

Full list of PANELKI 1.4.0 updates:

Update to Unreal Engine 5
AMD graphics cards shutdown fixed
Graphics changes, including improved light and shadows, window glow and many others
Animation of falling from a great height
Restricted network play to two people (apologies, couldn't fix >2 people)
Fixed roof clearing
Improved character animations
Improved cinematic mode
Improved performance of low game settings
Added varieties of lights in house windows and interior lamps in entrances
Changed colors of fog and sky when changing time of day
Improved display of fonts in the main menu
Improved textures of houses and asphalt
Fixed holes in high snow slides
Fixed screen resolution change setting
Improved user experience of single player game creation
Fixed display of instructions in DLC delivery
.

Unfortunately, there is no support for old game saves in the new version. But you can always roll back to a previous version of the game via the “beta versions” section.

As always, you can leave bug reports in the appropriate thread in the “discussions” section of Steam Community.

You are also welcome to join the game's new Discord community, where you can discuss the update, find a friend to play together, or berate the developer: https://discord.gg/trrgWXYjkz
Telegram channel of the game: @panelkigame

I'm grateful to every player who has played the game over these two and a half years, and to all those who choose to do so afterward. Thank you for this journey. ːSEMENː

- Alexander Gromyko

notes.title: PANELKI 1.3.0 HOTFIX
notes.notes:
Thank you for your feedback after the release of Update 1.3.0.
Major and minor issues in online and single player games have been fixed.

Updates
(for 12.24.22 and 12.29.22)

Fixed crashes in multiplayer*
Added chat to multiplayer
Added notifications about players joining and leaving the server
Added hints for new items and objects
Fixed game crash during the doorbell
Fixed display of the number of players in the session
Fixed loading of saved games (single and multiplayer) and game mode in saves
Fixed saving and loading of players connecting to the host
Intercom sound is configured on all clients
Fixed an issue with the inclusion of several music sources on the host
Fixed tablet operation on one of the intercoms
Incorrect operation of the cleaning after dogs function has been fixed
The visibility of garbage in the inventory when collecting garbage bags has been fixed
Fixed pickup points in DLC delivery
Fixed order display in DLC delivery
Fixed message from Еда.Club


* In some cases, crashes may still occur. I did everything I could to reduce them. If you or your players are experiencing crashes, try one of the following steps:
- The player who crashes should log in last (always works)
- Check the integrity of the game files in Steam, delete saves, including SaveMain.sav (C:\Users\[your username]\AppData\Local\PanelkiProject\Saved\SaveGames)
- Reinstall game and delete saves

I apologize for the inconvenience caused.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: PANELKI 1.3.0 MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
The significant update 1.3.0 with multiplayer is out!

Multiplayer
A full multiplayer game is available from the main menu. You can create a server or join an existing one.
If you are creating a private server, tell the others players the PIN from the pause menu.
If you see some bugs while playing multiplayer, please report them in a special section in the game's community on Steam.

Graffiti Pack DLC
Find graffiti sprays and paint graffiti on any building. Even in online play!
You can purchase additional content at Steam.

New ending movie
Just play through the game again. It's worth it.

Christmas Tree
A Christmas tree now spawning on the map. It can be decorated with Christmas decorations. You can find them in the basements. Add a festive atmosphere to the city!

Warming drink
Now you can buy a warming drink in 24/7 markets. It seems to be a juice...

Other changes and bugfixes:
- The ball no longer lifts the player into the air
- Buildings now despawn correctly
- Correct saves
- and much more

And also A LOT of work on optimizing the game.

Now you can buy the game via telegram bot: @panelkigamebot

Have a good game!

notes.title: PANELKI 1.2.0 MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Tired of the 30-degree heat outside? It's time to return to the cold city of PANELKI, because the biggest update has been released in the game!

The game has reached 2500 unique players, which means it's time for a new DLC, soundtrack, and lots of other changes!


Delivery DLC
The downloadable content «Delivery» is a new game mode where you will play as a food courier! You can purchase a DLC in Steam store.

Mode features:

 Look for shops in the city and pick up orders (the main thing is not to eat along the way).
 Deliver orders to the right addresses (the wind will direct you).
 Call the intercoms to get customers to let you into the house (and warm up).
 Earn a ticket to leave the endless city of panel houses (again?)


New soundtrack
Brand new generative soundtrack. Atmospheric ambient compositions for the infinite panel city, written specifically for the game by Victor Golumbevskii. 
Благодаря технологии генеративной музыки, композиции переплетаются между собой, выводя уникальные мелодии. Новое звучание Панелек доступно во всех режимах.

You also can purchase a soundtrack in Steam store, and soon you will hear the soundtrack in music streaming services.

New sounds
New sounds have been added to the game. Immerse yourself even more in the atmosphere of the northern city when you are sent in a known direction from the other end of the intercom!

 When calling the intercom
 When the doorbell rings


New achievements
Five new achievements:

 Intern
 Hard worker
 Employee of the month
 New job (Delivery DLC)
 Came to apologize (Delivery DLC)

And also updated icons for all of the old achievements.

Free game mode:
Now you can start a new game in free mode after completing main game. You have all the items, as well as the unlimited capacity of shovels and number of snowballs from start. In a word, sandbox.
In free mode, by going into cinematic mode, you can speed up time and weather to create beautiful shots.

Other changes:

 New randomness of items in the basement. Now the drop rate of items depends on the items already present in the player.
 Increased the chance of a yellow shovel spawn.
 Now, in order to warm up in the entrance, you must first turn on the heating in the house.
 Improved flashlight light.
 The number of air conditioners on the facade of houses has been reduced.
 Improved optimization.


Bugfixes:

 The tooltip stuck when filling a shovel has been fixed.
 Reset the blur slider in the camera.



DLC and a soundtrack now available in Steam store, which you can buy both separately and as a bundle with the game - it will turn out to be more profitable (if you don't have the game yet).


If you find any bug, then please write about it in a special section in the game forum. Thank you!

Now you can buy PANELKI via telegram bot: @panelkigamebot

With love from Russia! <3
